method: Fresh processes,20-second cap per case,1 row/1 column. Full public split construction and rows/entries collect including Matrix expansion and final sorting. Input construction and runtime warmup excluded from action. Peak RSS is whole process and includes input/runtime. Baseline original variant.py loaded as vail package module from git show113f8ba0; identical current runtime. All result values checked. Baseline caps include construction and action, so no isolated kernel speedup ratio is claimed.
limits: All-alternate prepared arrays remain attached temporarily during Matrix row expansion; prepared payload replication is quadratic in allele count, within diploid PL input-size order. Original quadratic PL vector removed before explosion, avoiding its former cubic duplication.
Output row key sorting remains required. One-row bounded evidence is not a production scaling guarantee.

Missing GT yields missing PL; absent GT uses diploid PL; missing likelihood elements ignored for bucket minima. Validation executes when relevant values are demanded; count-only actions may prune value evaluation.
